content:
As of **2024**, the estimated population of the **United States** is approximately **339–340 million people**, according to the **U.S. Census Bureau** and **United Nations** projections.

### Key Data Points:
- **2023 Estimate**: ~334.9 million (U.S. Census Bureau, July 2023)
- **2024 Projection**: ~339–340 million (growing at ~0.5% annually)
- **World Rank**: **3rd** (after India and China)

### Sources:
1. **[U.S. Census Bureau](https://www.census.gov/)** (official population clock)
2. **[World Bank](https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.POP.TOTL?locations=US)**
3. **[United Nations](https://population.un.org/wpp/)**
